01-110.stem: If \(b \neq a + c\) and \(\frac{1}{b - a} + \frac{1}{b - c} = \frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{c}\), then \(a, b, c\) are in
01-110.solution: Rearranging, \(\frac{1}{b - a} - \frac{1}{c} = \frac{1}{a} - \frac{1}{b - c}\) gives \(\frac{a + c - b}{c(b - a)} = -\frac{a + c - b}{a(b - c)}\). Since \(b \neq a + c\), cancel \(a + c - b\): \(a(b - c) = -c(b - a)\), so \(ab + bc = 2ac\), that is \(b = \frac{2ac}{a + c}\). So \(a, b, c\) are in HP.
01-110.reason: Notes review (2026-10-22): the condition also holds whenever b = a + c (1, 4, 3 is no HP); the stem now excludes that case and the solution cancels the factor. Key C stands.
